problem:
Given that $x,y\in {C}^{4},$ compute the standard Hermitian inner product $⟨x,y⟩$ of the following two vectors.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 1+2i \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}2+i \\ -3 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Using the definition of the standard Hermitian inner product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & ={x}_{1}\overset{―}{{y}_{1}}+{x}_{2}\overset{―}{{y}_{2}}+{x}_{3}\overset{―}{{y}_{3}}+{x}_{4}\overset{―}{{y}_{4}} \\  & =(-1)\cdot \overset{―}{(2+i)}+2\cdot (\overset{―}{-3})+(1+2i)\cdot \overset{―}{1}+1\cdot \overset{―}{2} \\  & =(-1)\cdot (2-i)+2\cdot (-3)+(1+2i)\cdot 1+1\cdot 2 \\  & =(-2+i)+(-6)+(1+2\text{i})+2 \\  & =-5+3i.\end{aligned}
$$
